sync.still_connecting: Still connecting to the sync server.
sync.in_a_chain: This device is in a sync chain already. Leave it first.

sync.https_only: the sync server needs an https:// address (plain http only for this computer): {url}
sync.unreadable_answer: the sync server sent an answer this version cannot read
sync.status_400: the sync server did not understand the request

sync.status_409: another device wrote first; trying again

sync.busy: the sync server is busy; trying again later

sync.going_back: {name}: the server has version {remote} but this device has {seen}; not going back
sync.unreadable: cannot read it; is Magnetite up to date?
sync.no_data_yet: {name}: this sync chain holds no data yet; sync the device that started it first
sync.wrong_version: {name}: the server acknowledged version {acked} for a write of version {next}; ignored
